summary: A shared 80-deep cross-section on every plot: a cream-white calcite arcade bar (z 3..14, 8-block bays of round arches with a window above each, cornice and balustrade at y 29), a 49-wide nave under a low deepslate roof with a glazed monitor ridge at y 38, and a grey andesite bay bar. Plot 0 adds a smooth-quartz pavilion with three tall arches, 2 blocks proud, and a 15-wide tower rising to y 70 with four 11-wide clock dials, then two arched belfry stages that step in, a lantern, a dome and a flagpole at y 103. Plot 2 adds a taller corner block where the arcade turns onto the east face, plus grey halls with lunette gables. It reads as the Ferry Building because the white clock tower stands over the long arcade with the dark roof behind. Three tiling modules sharing one cross-section: pale calcite/quartz arcaded land front, tall grey-roofed nave with glazed monitor, grey bay halls. Plot 0 pavilion carries the 15-wide Giralda-style clock tower (four clock faces, two belfries, lantern, dome, flag). Six trade-cut parts.

masonry shell: parts/shell.mjs builds the masonry shell for all three plots. It covers the land-front arcade bars, the pavilion, bay-side bars with their halls and gables, the corner block, the nave floor and galleries, and every opening left as air. `./make.sh` finishes with no refused or off-palette writes in my part, and the render shows the right massing.
polish: Voussoir rings on the bay-side windows, the pavilion arches and the east arches of the corner block are not built; the shell leaves those openings plain.
The land-front plinth (polished_andesite y1) and the plot 2 east-face pilasters at x101 are not built.
The hall at the pavilion's back wall (z14) and the nave end opening at z14 are open air, with no doors or glass yet.
`$MCD check` and `$MCD fit` were not read: the check output was only grepped for floating or orphan blocks and showed none, and fit was not run. Walk/room reachability is also unchecked.
Entrance hall interior y23..29 and the tower keep are left empty for the tower part.
Plot 2's bay-side wall has no tall arched windows outside the cross-gables, and the corner block's attic floor sits at y26.

waste.tool: a wallWithOpenings(g, {box, openings:[{x,y,w,h,profile}]}) helper and a gableTriangle(g, {x0,x1,y0,z}) helper in vocab

summary:
windows and doors: parts/fittings.mjs is written: upper arched windows, wing shop doors and panes, pavilion three arches (door pairs, posts, transom, glazing), bay-side arched windows, and the plot 0, plot 2 cross-gable and east-end lunettes.
In make.sh every one of its 1704 writes is refused by runParts' lock, because the masonry shell places its openings as air and the lock counts air. The geometry checks out in a lock-free preview (shell then fittings, front and back elevations read correctly).
Blocker for the shell owner or the library: the shell must leave openings unwritten, or runParts must lock only solid cells. Logged in plan.md Notes.
polish: make.sh runs and writes a whole build.nbt, but none of P4's openings are filled in it: all 1704 writes are REFUSED by runParts' lock because the shell's air carves count as placed. Fix in parts/shell.mjs (leave openings unwritten instead of calcite-then-air) or in runParts (lock only solid cells), then re-run make.sh.

Arcade shop-door and window connection states are set per cell by hand; the shop-door hinge and transom layout (x0+3..4 doors, y3 transom) is my choice and has not been checked in a rendered close-up.

Corner block (plot 2, x 81..100) upper windows and the east-face arches of the corner block (z 5..10 at x 100) are not built; no P4 element in elements.md covers them, so they are left for the corner-block owner.
The pavilion's jamb, post and transom polished_deepslate cells are my reading of the plan's arch infill; the plan lists only doors, transom and glazing.
plan.md has no per-part checklist to tick; the status is recorded in its Notes instead.
Scratch files left in the part directory: preview-fittings.mjs (lock-free preview, not in make.sh), preview.nbt, preview-sheet.png and tiles-preview/.

make.sh produces a whole build.nbt with this part. The shop/redstone sockets brief does not apply here: this plan has no sockets.json and no shops.

summary:

make.sh finished and wrote a whole build.nbt. On a scratch copy with the y56 deck the room reads OK, walk and light both pass.
polish: The real build's room check still says NEEDS WORK: the tower part has not laid the deck under the room yet. The room needs a solid deck at y56 across x17..29, z2..14, with a hole at x18 z8 for the ladder. The room tool then reads the floor at y57, as the plan's FLOORS table says. With that deck in a scratch copy, the walk from the ladder landing reaches 164 of 168 floor cells (the 4 unreached cells are the tops of the lanterns) and light is min 8, 0 dark.

plan.md Notes (the stairs line) say 'decks at y33 and y57'. That conflicts with the room box y57..69 being inner air, which needs the deck at y56. The tower builder should use y56, or the plan should be corrected.
The stairs part's ladder at x18 y33..69 is unsupported (nothing behind it at x17): the tower's wall x17 must be built, or the ladder is reported as floating in check.

No plan.md checklist entry or elements.md item is ticked: plan.md has no room-part checklist, and elements.md item 20 (lighting) covers the whole building, not just this room. The clock room lights are four standing lanterns on barrel side tables and one on the bench, plus the glowstone behind the dials (built by the clock-lights part).
